name: Line Draw + Annotation
easing: axes f0-18; line EASE.inOut f18-64; circle EASE.out f66-78; note wipe EASE.inOut f76-92
bestFor: A trend with one moment worth pointing at ('Real-world jump').
keyframeTable: line complete; orange circle starting at last point
script: Axes draw, the line draws left to right with dots appearing as it passes them.
An orange pen circle draws around the last point, a leader line and note follow.
colorRules: Circle, leader and note orange; line cream.
